opportunities.title: I will no longer mistake rapid scaffolding for system design.
opportunities.text: I will no longer mistake rapid scaffolding for system design. The illusion of progress breaks when the implementation hits a wall that code cannot climb. You can prompt an agent to generate a Rust daemon with four retrieval strategies reranked by small local models, but the agent cannot solve the structural rot that follows when those strategies fail to maintain a coherent truth. The problem is not the language or the retrieval logic. It is the fundamental gap between generating a functional component and architecting a reliable system. When an agent builds a tool, it builds a collection of parts that work in isolation.
